title: Havoc from the dark portal
flavor: The Abyssal Underlord - so mysterious that neither myth nor song exist to tell of their coming. Vrogros is able to conjure forth flame and crippling malice through the twist between worlds. By his command the first waves of abyssal invaders have already marched through his dark portal, a few doomed legions meant merely to test the might of nations above. Now, with his armies fully prepared for endless conquest, Vrogros himself stepped into the sunlit world, announcing his impending reign. Now, as his full force readies itself for unending conquest, Vrogros himself steps into a sunlit world to announce his coming reign. Those who face the Underlord will bow and pay tribute, or be crushed where they stand. Game Optimization

New Piece
entries.detail: Abyssal Underlord ($5, Demon/Warlock), Ability - Fiend’s Gate <Battlecry Ability: Activates on battle> Opens a portal connecting with the dark spaceThe gate calls demons of the same rank with Underlord continuously and consuming its own health on each call until it is damaged or used up. P.S. The gate has an initial Health equal to the sum of Level of all ally demons. Each demon called consumes its own health equal to the Cost of this piece. P.S. The gate is considered as Ward and immune to ability damage. P.S. Demons called can extend the Fel power of Underlord but the stack counts independently. They come without warning, leaving fire and blood where kingdoms once flourished.
